web/composer/provider_telemetry.py:R4:_l: R4 `except Exception: return` wrapping the structlog call inside `_log_projection_failure`. This is the terminal fallback of the telemetry failure path — there is no further reporting channel to route to, so naming another control would be a fiction: the control IS that this function is the last stop and that everything it reports is subordinate to an outcome already committed elsewhere. Every caller reaches it only AFTER the durable audit write has settled (`record_settled_composer_provider_calls` and `record_settled_composer_audit_message` project post-commit facts; `finish_composer_request_metrics` projects a request aggregate at teardown), so a logger that is itself broken must not convert an operator-metrics problem into a failed composer request that the user sees. Re-raising here would invert the subordination the module exists to maintain, and would do so at the one site with no remaining handler. The swallow is bounded to a single logging statement with no other side effect. Invalidated if this helper ever acquires a second responsibility beyond emitting one structured log line.
